name: Hinoki Yui
source:
An independent virtual idol featured on "Yui.ch" (Yui Channel). She entertains her viewers mainly with chatting and gaming streams.

[spoiler]A technical glitch during one of her early streams revealed that her nakanohito (the actor behind the character) is [url=/c91970]Hibikino Yui[/url].[/spoiler]
